policy.heading: Platform policy
policy.help: Defaults and limits every project must author within. Locking a switch forces every activity type to match it, and is re-checked when a facilitator starts an activity, so tightening reaches activity types that already exist. Locking agent visibility off also stops submitted content reaching agents in rooms that are already mid-activity; the activity itself keeps running until a facilitator ends it.
policy.neverSaved: No policy has been saved yet, so the platform is running permissively.
policy.exposeHelp: Whether participant answers reach an AI agent, and therefore an LLM provider. This is a consent and ethics decision, not a preference.
policy.echoHelp: Whether participant answers appear in the shared room transcript.
policy.retentionHelp: The default retention a project starts from, and the longest it may set. Leave either blank for no value.
policy.retentionInvalid: Retention must be a whole number of days, or blank for no value. Nothing has been saved.
policy.saveFailed: Could not save the policy. Please try again.
policy.previewFailed: Could not check the impact. Please try again.
policy.conflict: Someone else changed the policy while this form was open. It has been reloaded; review and save again.
policy.impact: This policy would stop {count} existing activity types from being started until a project owner edits them.
policy.impactApprox: This policy would stop at least {count} existing activity types from being started until a project owner edits them.
policy.impactRunning: {count} activities are running right now that this policy would refuse. They will keep running until a facilitator ends them: the policy is enforced when an activity is authored and when it starts, not while it is under way.
policy.impactNone: No existing activity type would be blocked, and nothing is running that this policy would refuse.
